description: This file defines the ServiceEngine class, which models the <service-engine> XML element in the OFBiz framework. It includes configuration details such as authorization, thread pools, engines, service locations, notification groups, and other related components.

classes.name: ServiceEngine
classes.description: Represents the <service-engine> configuration element, encapsulating authorization, engine list, service locations, notification groups, startup services, resource loaders, global services, service groups, service ECAs, JMS services, and thread pool.

methods.name: getAuthorization
methods.description: Returns the authorization configuration for the service engine.

methods.name: getEngine
methods.description: Retrieves a specific Engine object by its name.

methods.name: getEngines
methods.description: Returns the list of Engine objects associated with this service engine.

methods.name: getGlobalServices
methods.description: Returns the list of global services configured.

methods.name: getJmsServiceByName
methods.description: Finds and returns a JMS service by its name.

methods.name: getJmsServices
methods.description: Returns the list of JMS services.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the service engine.

methods.name: getNotificationGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of notification groups.

methods.name: getResourceLoaders
methods.description: Returns the list of resource loaders.

methods.name: getServiceEcas
methods.description: Returns the list of service ECAs.

methods.name: getServiceGroups
methods.description: Returns the list of service groups.

methods.name: getServiceLocations
methods.description: Returns the list of service locations.

methods.name: getStartupServices
methods.description: Returns the list of startup services.
